title: God's About to Drop the Hammer
paragraphs: This is the message God gave to Micah from Moresheth. It happened back when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah. It was all about the drama going down in Samaria and Jerusalem.
Listen up, everyone! Earth, you and everyone on it, pay attention: The Lord GOD is about to testify against you, coming straight from His holy temple.

Look, here He comes! God is on the move from His place! He comes down and strides across the mountains and hills. The mountains are sinking under His feet, and the valleys are splitting wide open — rocky mountains crumbling into gravel, river valleys leaking like sieves. This is all happening because of Jacob's screw-up, because the house of Israel messed up. You ask what Jacob's big sin is? Just look at Samaria — isn't it obvious? And all the sex-and-religion shrines in Judah — isn't Jerusalem responsible?

“So I'm about to turn Samaria into a heap of rubble, a vacant lot littered with garbage. I'll dump the stones from her buildings into the valley and leave her abandoned foundations exposed. All her carved and cast gods and goddesses will be sold for stove wood and scrap metal. All her sacred fertility groves will be burned to the ground, and all the sticks and stones she worshiped as gods — destroyed. These were her earnings from her life as a prostitute, and that's exactly what happens to a prostitute's wages.”

This is why I lament and mourn. This is why I go around in rags and barefoot. This is why I howl like a pack of coyotes and moan like a mournful owl in the night. God has inflicted punishing wounds — Judah's been wounded with no healing in sight. Judgment has marched through the city gates, and Jerusalem must face the charges.

Don't gossip about this in Telltown. Don't even waste your tears. In Dustville, roll in the dust. In Alarmtown, the alarm is going off. The citizens of Exitburgh will never get out alive. Lament for Last-Stand City — there's nothing left standing there. The villagers of Bittertown wait in vain for sweet peace. Harsh judgment has come from God and marched right into Peace City. All you who live in Chariotville, get in your chariots and run for it! You led the daughter of Zion into trusting chariots instead of God. The same kind of sins in Israel got their start with you too. Go ahead, hand your good-bye gifts to Good-byeville. Miragetown waved you in but left Israel's kings disappointed. Inheritance City has lost its inheritance. Glorytown has seen its last of glory. Shave your heads in mourning over your precious towns. Go bald as a goose egg — they're headed into exile and they're not coming back.

title: God's Plan vs. Theirs: It's Over
paragraphs: It's so over for you guys who lie in bed dreaming up ways to do people wrong. First thing in the morning, you're up and at 'em, using all your energy to make it happen. You see a field you like, you just grab it. You find a house you want, you just take it. You bully a guy and his whole family, only seeing people for what you can get from them. But God is so done. He's like, "I've got some plans of my own: disaster with your name on it, because of this interbreeding evil! You're all on the chopping block now. There's no getting away from this one. It's your doomsday." People are gonna make up roast tracks about you, and you'll be the ones singing the blues: 'We're totally wrecked, our homes and lands are being auctioned off. They're taking everything and leaving us with nothing! It's all going to the highest bidder.' And there'll be no one to stand up for you, no one to speak for you before God and his jury.

"Stop preaching," the preachers are saying. "Don't preach all that negative stuff. Nothing bad is gonna happen to us. Why are you talking like this to Jacob's family? Does God just lose his temper? Is this really how He acts? Isn't He on the side of good people? Doesn't He help those who help themselves?"

"'Good people'? Seriously? You're the real enemy of my people! You jump people who are just out for a chill evening walk. You literally take the coats off their backs like you're looting in a war zone. You force the women of my people out of their own nice homes. You turn their kids into victims, leaving them exposed to all kinds of messed-up stuff. Get out of here, all of you. This isn't your chill spot anymore! You've contaminated this place, and now you're contaminated—totally ruined! But hey, if some guy showed up with a charming smile and a smooth tongue, lying 24/7 like, 'I'll preach you a sermon on how to get anything you want from God: more cash, the best wine... you name it'—you'd make him your personal preacher on the spot.

"I'm calling a meeting, Jacob. I want everyone back—every last survivor of Israel. I'm gonna gather them all in one place, like a whole flock of sheep in a pen, like cattle in a corral—a massive, milling throng of homebound people! Then I, God, will burst through every confinement and lead them out into the open. They'll follow their King. And I'll be right there at the front, leading the way."

title: God vs. Corrupt Leaders: It's a Showdown

splits.note: MSG 1-3 한 단락을 도입부("Then I said:")와 본문으로 분리 — 내용 손실 없음, 가독성 목적

paragraphs: Then I said:

“Alright, listen up, you so-called leaders of Jacob and Israel. Do you even know what justice is? Seriously? You guys hate what's good and love what's evil. Isn't justice, like, your main job? But instead, you're skinning my people alive, ripping the meat right off their bones. You break their bones, chop them up, and throw them in a pot like you're making some kind of messed-up stew.
But a time is coming when you'll be crying out to God for help, and He's gonna leave you on read. He's gonna turn His back on you because of all the messed-up stuff you've done.

And here's God's message to the prophets who are straight-up lying to my people: As long as they're getting paid and eating good, they're all like, 'Life is amazing! Peace and love, everyone!' But if you don't pay up and jump on their bandwagon, their 'God bless you' turns into 'God damn you.' So, guess what? You're going blind. You won't see a thing. You'll be living in the shadows, completely clueless. The sun has set on you prophets. Your time in the spotlight is over. From now on, it's all darkness. The visionaries will be confused, and the experts will be all mixed up. They'll hide behind their reputations and make lame excuses for not knowing God.
But me? I'm filled with God's power. I've got His Spirit of justice and strength, and I'm ready to call out Jacob for their crimes and Israel for their sin.

You leaders of Jacob and Israel are a piece of work. You laugh at justice and twist the truth. You're building up your precious city, Zion, on the backs of the people you've killed, and expanding Jerusalem with your crimes. The judges are selling their verdicts to the highest bidder, the priests are selling their teachings like merch, and the prophets are preaching for cash. And all the while, you're pretending to be tight with God, saying, 'We've got God on our side. He'll protect us from disaster.' Because of people like you, Zion will be turned back into a farm, Jerusalem will become a pile of rubble, and instead of the Temple on the mountain, a few scraggly scrub pines.

title: The Ultimate Comeback Story
paragraphs: But look, when it all goes down, God's Temple on the mountain — firmly fixed — is gonna dominate all the mountains, towering above the surrounding hills. People from all over the world are gonna flock to it, and tons of nations will head there, saying, 'Come on, let's climb God's mountain. Let's go to the Temple of Jacob's God. He's gonna teach us how to live. We'll learn how to live God's way.' Real teaching is gonna come out of Zion, God's revelation straight from Jerusalem. He's gonna bring justice to the wildest nations and settle beefs in the most far-off places. They're gonna swap their swords for shovels, their spears for rakes and hoes. Nations will stop fighting each other and stop learning how to kill. Every dude will chill under his own shade tree, every woman will tend her own garden in safety. God-of-the-Angel-Armies said it, and He means business.
Meanwhile, everyone else is just doing whatever, picking their own gods. But us? We're sticking with our God, staying loyal forever.

'On that great day,' God says, 'I'm gonna gather up everyone who's been hurt and kicked out, everyone I have bruised or banished. I'm gonna turn the battered into an elite crew. I'm gonna make the long-lost into a strong nation — a showcase exhibit of God's rule in action, as I rule from Mount Zion, from here to eternity.'
'And you stragglers around Jerusalem, just trying to get by in your shantytowns: the old glory is coming back. Jerusalem's daughter will be the kingdom center again.'

So why are you all freaking out? Don't you have a king? Is he slacking off or something, making you panic like a woman in labor? Well, go ahead — twist and scream, Daughter Jerusalem. It's gonna feel like childbirth. You'll be kicked out of the city, forced to camp out in the open. Then you'll end up in Babylon. But here's the plot twist: what you lose in Jerusalem, you'll get back in Babylon. God will rescue you and give you a fresh start, right from under your enemies' noses.

But for now, a bunch of godless nations are teaming up against you. They're saying, 'Kick her when she's down! Violate her! We want to see Zion grovel in the dirt.' These blasphemers have no clue what God is thinking or doing here. They don't get that this is the making of God's people — that they're wheat being threshed, gold being refined.

On your feet, Daughter of Zion! Be threshed till the chaff is gone, be refined till the dross is gone. I'm making you an unstoppable force, God's own juggernaut to crush the godless nations. You'll bring their plunder as holy offerings to God, their wealth to the Master of the whole earth.

title: The Small-Town King with the Ultimate Glow-Up
paragraphs: But for now, prepare for the worst, victim daughter! The siege is set against us. They humiliate Israel's king, slapping him around like a rag doll.

But yo, listen up. Bethlehem, from David's old stomping grounds — you might be considered a nobody, the runt of the litter. But out of you is gonna come the leader who will shepherd-rule Israel. And this ain't some random new guy or pretender; his family tree is ancient and distinguished. Meanwhile, Israel will be in foster homes until the birth pangs are over and the child is born, and the scattered brothers come back home to the family of Israel. He'll stand tall in his shepherd-rule by God's strength, centered in the majesty of the revealed God. And the people will have a good and safe home, for the whole world will hold him in respect — Peacemaker of the world!

And if some bullying Assyrian shows up, invades and violates our land, don't worry. We'll put him in his place, send him packing, and watch his every move. Shepherd-rule will extend as far as needed, to Assyria and all the other Nimrod-bullies. Our shepherd-ruler will save us from old or new enemies, from anyone who invades or violates our land.

The purged and select crew of Jacob will be like an island in the sea of peoples. They'll be like dew from God, like summer showers not mentioned in the weather forecast, not subject to calculation or control.

Yes, the purged and select crew of Jacob will be like an island in the sea of peoples, like the king of beasts among wild beasts, like a young lion loose in a flock of sheep — killing and devouring the lambs, and no one able to stop him. With your arms raised in triumph over your foes, your enemies will be no more!

'The day is coming' — God's Decree — 'when there will be no more war. None. I'll slaughter your war horses and demolish your chariots. I'll dismantle military posts and level your fortifications. I'll abolish your religious black markets, your underworld trade in black magic. I will smash your carved and cast gods and chop down your Asherah poles. No more taking control of the world, worshiping what you do or make. I'll root out your sacred sex-and-power centers and destroy the God-defiant. In raging anger, I'll make a clean sweep of godless nations who haven't listened.'

title: God's Got a Complaint... And He's Not Holding Back

splits.note: MSG 1-2 한 단락을 도입부("Listen now, listen to God:")와 법정 소환 본문으로 분리 — 내용 손실 없음, 가독성 목적

paragraphs: Listen up, listen to God — He's laying it all out.

"Get ready for court. If you've got a beef, tell it to the mountains; make your case to the hills. And now, you mountains, listen to God's case; you, Earth's jury, pay attention—'cause I'm bringing charges against my own people. I'm building a case against Israel."

"My people, how have I wronged you? Have I been a burden, worn you out? Seriously, tell me! I'm the one who got you out of that terrible life in Egypt; I paid a high price to free you from slavery. I sent Moses to lead you—and Aaron and Miriam too! Don't you remember what King Balak of Moab tried to pull, and how Balaam son of Beor flipped the script on him? Remember all those stories from Shittim to Gilgal. You gotta keep all of God's salvation stories fresh in your mind."

So, how do I even show up before God and show proper respect to the high God? Should I roll up with a ton of offerings, like some prime year-old calves? Would God be impressed with thousands of rams, with buckets and barrels of olive oil? Would He be moved if I sacrificed my firstborn, my own precious kid, just to cancel out my sin?

But for real, He's already made it super clear how to live, what to do, and what He's looking for in men and women. It's actually pretty simple: Do what's right and fair to others, be compassionate and loyal in your love, and don't take yourself too seriously—take God seriously.
Yo, pay attention! God's calling out the city! If you know what's good for you, you'll listen. So listen up, everyone! This is major.

'Do you expect me to overlook the obscene wealth you've piled up by cheating and fraud? Do you think I'll tolerate your shady deals and shifty scheming? I'm tired of the violent rich bullying their way with bluffs and lies. I'm fed up. Beginning now, you're finished. You'll pay for your sins down to your last cent. No matter how much you get, it will never be enough — hollow stomachs, empty hearts. No matter how hard you work, you'll have nothing to show for it — bankrupt lives, wasted souls. You'll plant grass but never get a lawn. You'll make jelly but never spread it on your bread. You'll press apples but never drink the cider. You've been living by the standards of your king, Omri, the decadent lifestyle of the family of Ahab. Because you've slavishly followed their fashions, I'm forcing you into bankruptcy. Your way of life will be laughed at, a tasteless joke. Your lives will be derided as futile and fake.'

title: Down But Not Out: The Ultimate Comeback Story

splits.note: MSG 1-6 한 단락을 1-2(절망 묘사)와 3-6(부패 묘사)으로 분리 — 내용 손실 없음, 가독성 목적

paragraphs: Man, I'm overwhelmed with sorrow, sunk in a swamp of despair! I'm like someone who goes to the garden to pick cabbages and carrots and corn, and comes back empty-handed — nothing for soup or sandwich or salad. There's literally not one decent person in sight. Right-living humans have gone extinct. They're all out for one another's blood, animals preying on each other.

They've all become experts in evil. Corrupt leaders demand bribes, and the powerful rich make sure they get what they want. The best and brightest are thistles. The top of the line is crabgrass. But no longer — it's exam time. Look at them slinking away in disgrace! Don't trust your neighbor, don't confide in your friend. Watch your words, even with your spouse. Neighborhoods and families are falling to pieces. The closer they are — sons, daughters, in-laws — the worse they can be. Your own family is the enemy.
But me? I'm not giving up. I'm sticking around to see what God's gonna do. I'm waiting for God to come through and make things right. I'm counting on Him to hear me out.

Don't crow over me, enemy. I might be down, but I'm definitely not out. Yeah, I'm sitting in the dark right now, but God is my light. I can take God's punishing rage. I messed up, I sinned, so I deserve it. But I know it won't last forever. He's on my team and He's going to get me out of this mess. He'll turn on the lights and show me His ways. I'll finally see the whole picture and how right He is. And my enemy will see it too, and be discredited — yes, disgraced! This enemy who kept taunting me, 'So where is this God of yours?' I'm going to see it with these, my own eyes — my enemy disgraced, trash in the gutter.

Oh, that's gonna be a legendary day! A day to rebuild your city, a day for stretching your arms, spreading your wings! All your people who were scattered everywhere will come back home, old friends and family from all over the world, from Assyria in the east to Egypt in the west, from across the oceans and over the mountains. But for everyone else, it's gonna be the opposite—a total ghost town—all because of how they chose to live and the messed-up things they did.

God, please shepherd your people with your staff, your dear and precious flock. Uniquely yours in a grove of trees, centered in lotus land. Let them graze in lush Bashan, as in the old days in green Gilead. Bring back the miracle-wonders of our exodus from Egypt. And the godless nations — put them in their place: humiliated in their arrogance, speechless and clueless. Make them slink like snakes, crawl like cockroaches, come out of their holes from under their rocks and face our God. Fill them with holy fear and trembling.

Where is another god who even compares to you? You wipe our slate clean of all guilt — turning a blind eye, a deaf ear, to the past sins of your purged and precious people. You don't nurse your anger, and you don't stay angry long, because showing mercy is your thing. That's what you love to do most. And compassion is on its way to us. You'll crush all our wrongdoing. You'll throw our sins into the deepest part of the ocean. You'll keep your promise to Father Jacob and continue to show the same love you showed Grandfather Abraham — everything you promised our ancestors a long, long time ago.
